Nadia, Gideon landed on **280 seats** for Vantorre Group. I posted that as a reply to your message in #strategic-pod.

In his July 1 update he first said 300, then corrected himself a few minutes later. The 300 came from a staging tab that included sandbox logins from the May rollout. The production roster had 280 active seats as of Jul 1, and Ruth confirmed the corrected number.

Use 280 for the roster sheet. That figure is as of July 1, and I can't see anything newer in the channel.
